text:
Situation: Pregabalin 300 mg capsules are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Current inventory provides 43 days at Corvale East, 26.2 days at Corvale General, and 18.7 days at Corvale Lakeside based on recent daily usage.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include pregabalin as of 2026-10-21. A Bryant Ranch Prepack label (FEI 1000519407) shows a registered plant with a VAI inspection on 2026-07-16. That plant received an OAI classification in 2009 and a Warning Letter on 2010-04-08, but its most recent inspection was VAI.

Our position: Supply is adequate at two sites and low at Lakeside. No FDA shortage exists. The top purchasing options are not on FDA's shortage list today, though their labels name no identifiable plant for our review.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc. for Corvale Lakeside to extend days on hand; requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to evaluate Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited, Amneal Pharmaceuticals NY LLC, Ascend Laboratories LLC, and Aurobindo Pharma Limited as secondary sources; requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to monitor daily usage at all three sites and report weekly to pharmacy director; requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: No clinical substitutions or formulary changes at this time.
